title: Killa Cold X Mint Nic Pouches - 13.2mg / pouch
description: Killa Cold X Mint Nicotine Pouches provide an intense mint flavour, perfect for those who prefer a bold and refreshing taste paired with a balanced nicotine experience. Each pouch contains 13.2mg of nicotine, making it a suitable choice for adult users who enjoy a steady and satisfying nicotine release. The Cold X Mint flavour offers a crisp and invigorating taste, delivering a smooth, long-lasting experience. These pouches are entirely tobacco-free, offering a clean and convenient alternative to traditional nicotine products. The discreet design of Killa Cold X Mint pouches makes them ideal for use in various settings, whether you're on the move, at work, or in a social environment where traditional nicotine use isn’t feasible. Killa Nicotine Pouches are crafted with a focus on consistency and quality, ensuring a reliable nicotine experience. Simply place a pouch between your upper lip and gum, and enjoy a steady release of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With 20 pouches per pack, Killa Cold X Mint offers a practical and refreshing option for those who enjoy a cool, minty twist while relieving nicotine cravings. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a steady nicotine release for up to 30min. 2 Place the used nicotine pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
